Pinned commit: 6134f1c380dec3170376bf3f4d37d19a6ce0e880

Unchanged .NET Standard convex-hull core, shared by the Unity Editor and Player.
The Editor rebuilds complete convex faces for each CoACD-generated part and
checks the native vertex/polygon budget before it becomes an asset. The camera
prepares the displayed hull's visibility witnesses once at startup in Player.
No binaries, WPF packages, examples or triangulation API files are included.
Native Unity/PhysX remains the runtime collision engine.
Download hashes: tmp/contact_audio_20261028/research/MIConvexHull/download_manifest.json.
